lăm.en: five, after mười or mươi (mười lăm = 15)

linh.en: zero (for an empty tens place, as in 105)

anh.en: older brother; you (to a man a bit older)

chị.en: older sister; you (to a woman a bit older)

em.en: younger brother or sister; you (to someone younger)

cô.en: aunt; you (to a woman a bit younger than your parents)

chú.en: uncle; you (to a man a bit younger than your parents)

bạn.en: friend; you (to someone your own age)

quả.en: fruit; also the counting word for fruit

cân.en: a kilo; also: scale, to weigh

bớt.en: to take some off (a price); to reduce

hết.en: in total (of a bill); also: used up, sold out

mời.en: to invite; please (go ahead, have some)

cháu.en: grandchild, niece or nephew; I (to your parents' or grandparents' generation)

canh.en: soup (a clear broth eaten with rice)

nhăm.en: five after the tens, a casual spoken form of lăm (as in 25)

mốt.en: one, after the tens from 20 up

tư.en: four, after the tens from 20 up

chục.en: a set of ten things, as sellers count (ten eggs)
